title: Wait for it, then read the log
story: Submit run_mpnn.sh and wait for it to finish. A finished job disappears from squeue. Its output goes to slurm-JOBID.out. Report how many sequences it designed.

files.~/{{project}}/run_mpnn.sh:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=mpnn
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:1
#SBATCH --time=02:00:00
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --output=slurm-%j.out

module load anaconda
conda activate proteinmpnn

python protein_mpnn_run.py \
  --pdb_path inputs/target.pdb \
  --out_folder outputs/

jobRules.log:
Loading anaconda
Designing {{nseq}} sequences for inputs/target.pdb
Wrote outputs/seqs/target.fa
Job finished in 41.2 s

tasks.text: Report how many sequences it designed

hints: Run `squeue --me` every few seconds. When your job is gone from the list, it's done.
When it's done, `ls` shows a new slurm-NNNNN.out file. `cat` it.
`cat slurm-*.out` prints the log. Find "Designing N sequences", then type N in the answer box.
